_note: Texts the Mac app needs that core/desktop/design/strings.en.json doesn't have yet (the shared file is a copy of raven-core's and must stay identical to it). Every key starts with mac. and only adds a text: Strings.shared loads this file after strings.en.json and never lets it replace a shared key. Move each text into the shared file with raven-core, then delete it here (MacUXFixesTests fails while a key is in both).
mac.about.tagline: Messages straight to your friends. No Raven server.
mac.settings.network.lead: The ways Raven reaches your friends, as the Network page shows them. The Network page says more about each one.
mac.settings.reducedMotion.body: Nothing moves: no springs, no packets, no spinners. Texts still change. Raven also follows Reduce motion in macOS.
mac.settings.stored.plain: Not encrypted: settings that name no one (such as which ways to reach friends are on) and the log of the background program.
mac.settings.keepChats.body: Older chats are deleted from this computer. The copies your friends have are not.
mac.settings.forget: Forget the addresses of friends after 30 days without contact
mac.settings.erase.body: Removes your Raven identity, your friends and your chats from this computer. It cannot be undone.
mac.erase.body: This removes your Raven identity, your friends and your chats from this computer. It cannot be undone, and friends cannot reach you here until you set Raven up again.
mac.network.lab.body: This is a developer build: these switches turn on ways that are not released yet. Use it only for testing.
mac.network.mail.mine.notDecided: You have not decided yet whether friends may carry your mail.
mac.network.mail.mine.off: Friends do not carry your mail.
mac.network.help.bridge.plain: Passes on sealed envelopes for other Raven devices. Your messages to friends do not use it.
mac.network.hideIp: Hide the IP address of this computer from your friends
mac.network.proxy.auto: Automatic (the HTTPS proxy of this computer)
mac.network.relayForFriends.effect: Friends who use this relay see the IP address of this computer, and it uses bandwidth for every connection it relays. It helps only while this computer is on and reachable from the internet.
mac.network.thisComputer.policyUnreadabl: Raven could not read its network settings file, so it uses the defaults. Check network says more.
mac.network.consent.carryForFriends.does: While a verified friend is offline, this computer holds the sealed messages your other verified friends send them, until the Raven of that friend collects them (at most 24 hours; letters up to 7 days).
mac.network.consent.carryForFriends.cost: Disk space (at most 128 messages per pair of friends, 64 MiB in all) and some bandwidth when friends leave and collect mail. It helps only while this computer is on and the Raven background program runs.
mac.network.consent.friendsCarryMine.doe: When a friend cannot be reached, Raven may leave a sealed copy of your message with a friend you have both verified, and collect mail your friends hold for you. A copy waits at most 24 hours (a letter for a friend away longer than a day, up to 7 days).
mac.network.consent.friendsCarryMine.see: Your mail friends learn that you wrote to someone, to whom, when and how big it was, when your Raven checks in, and about how many of your contacts you are in touch with. The envelopes are signed, so the copy a friend holds is proof of who wrote to whom until it is deleted.
mac.network.consent.handoff.costs: Bandwidth and disk space for the messages it passes on or holds. It helps only while this computer is on and the Raven background program runs.
mac.network.restart.body: Some of these changes take effect only when the Raven background program starts again. Restarting takes a few seconds: Raven does not receive meanwhile, and waiting messages go out when it is back.
mac.network.restart.managed: A login service runs the Raven background program, so this app left it running. Restart that service (or sign out and in again) to use the changes.
mac.network.restart.notOurs: This app did not start the background program that runs now. Raven stops it if it can; if a login service runs it, Raven leaves it running and tells you how to restart it.
mac.network.restart.notStopped: The background program is still running, so the changes are not in use yet.
mac.network.check.intro: What Raven sees on your network now, and what to do next.
mac.network.check.router.body: Raven can ask the router of this computer how it opens ports (PCP, NAT PMP, UPnP). It only asks: nothing is opened, changed or saved. It takes up to about 4 seconds.
mac.network.check.router.macos: macOS may ask whether Raven may find devices on your local network: choose Allow, or the router cannot answer.
mac.network.routes.hideIp: Hide the IP address of this computer from {name}
mac.network.routes.hints.none: {name} has not told this computer any routes.
mac.network.routes.toldUnknown: Mail friends {name} told you about that are not your friends: {n}
mac.network.routes.relays: Relays for the peer to peer route (one per line, or separated by commas)
mac.network.routes.awayMeetFirst: To write to {name}, meet first: Raven cannot hold new messages for them now.
mac.network.routes.awayFirstMessage: A first message needs you and {name} both online (Raven has not connected with {name} yet).
mac.security.node.title: Counted by the Raven background program
mac.security.preview: Security notices are not in this version of Raven yet.
mac.security.kept.unsealed: This profile is not encrypted, so Raven keeps no security notices for it.
mac.security.resolve: Marking a notice as resolved is not in this app yet.
mac.updates.intro: What Raven knows about new versions.
mac.updates.notAvailable: Updates passed on by friends are not in this version of Raven yet.
mac.updates.install: Installing updates is not in this app yet.
mac.quit.running: The Raven background program keeps running while this computer is on and you stay logged in, so friends can still reach you and waiting messages keep trying.
mac.lock.locked.body: The Raven background program keeps running without its keys. It does not receive, read or send messages until you unlock.
mac.lock.locked.plainBody: While Raven is locked it does not receive, read or send messages. Unlock to use it again.
mac.lock.passphrase.note: Your passphrase goes only to the Raven background program on this computer.
mac.lock.confirm.does: Raven goes to sleep. It reads, receives and sends nothing until you wake it with your passphrase. Messages from friends wait safely on their side.
mac.lock.confirm.doesNoPassphrase: Raven goes to sleep. It reads, receives and sends nothing until you wake it. Messages from friends wait safely on their side.
mac.lock.confirm.doesNot: Lock does not protect against someone who uses this computer as you while Raven is unlocked, or against programs already running as you.
mac.lock.v2.body: Locking keeps the Raven background program running without its keys: it does not receive, read or send messages until you unlock.
mac.lock.notAvailable: Lock while running is not in this version of Raven yet.
mac.lock.notSupported: The Raven background program cannot lock now: it is not running, or it is an older version.
mac.lock.ready: Lock now keeps the Raven background program running without its keys: nothing is read or sent until you unlock.
mac.lock.passphrase.notInApp: Setting or changing a Raven passphrase is not in this app yet.
mac.lock.passphrase.body: Your Raven keys on this computer open only with your Raven passphrase. Unlocking asks for it.
mac.network.localOnly: Receiving on this computer only: friends on your network cannot reach you.
mac.network.process.app: Background program: running, started by this app
mac.settings.receive.body: To get messages, Raven keeps a small background program running that listens on your network. Only friends you add can send you anything.
mac.groups.remove.title: Remove {name} from {group}?
mac.groups.remove.body: {name} stops getting this group's messages and can't write to it. Messages so far stay on this computer.
mac.groups.remove.notFriend: {name} isn't your friend, so you can't add them back: only your friends can be added to a group.
mac.add.share.includeAddressNone: Include my network address. Anyone you send this to can see it.
mac.add.noAddress.notReceiving: Your card has no network address: Raven isn't receiving now. Your friend can still add you.
mac.add.noAddress.thisComputerOnly: Your card has no network address: Raven receives on this computer only (127.0.0.1), so friends on your network can't reach you.
mac.add.noAddress.noNetwork: Your card has no network address: this computer isn't on a network now.
mac.add.noAddress.other: Your card has no network address: Raven has none to share now.
mac.lock.plainBody: While Raven is locked it doesn't receive, read or send messages. Unlock to use it again.
